name: discover returns ACK
notes: v2 renamed search -> discover (docs/Communication_Protocol.md Migration Notes); Ack body is {message:{status,messageId}} (components/schemas/Ack). The harness MUST sign the request (Beckn HTTP Signature, docs/Authentication_and_Trust.md §4) and template context.bapId/bapUri/messageId/networkId with the harness's registered CN identity and a fresh UUID; an unsigned request is answered 401. timestamp/ttl are omitted so the fixture cannot go stale.
